sources.action_for_v508: Treat plugin/app readiness and settings discovery as first-class preflight rows before making any lane or connector claim.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol introduction
sources.current_signal: MCP defines a standard way for AI applications to connect to data sources, tools, and workflows.
sources.action_for_v508: Keep each route family explicit: Browser, CLI, app-server, official thread tools, and connectors must not be collapsed into one proof surface.

sources.title: OWASP Agentic AI threats and mitigations
sources.current_signal: Agentic systems expand operational capability and risk, so threat-model-based controls and mitigations should govern autonomous workflows.
sources.action_for_v508: Preserve no-replacement, read-only, least-privilege, status-only receipt, and explicit blocker rules as safety controls.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.current_signal: The framework identifies critical risks for autonomous and agentic systems that plan, act, and make decisions across workflows.
sources.action_for_v508: Make every phase-closeout guard prove route integrity, consent boundaries, private-data suppression, and no autonomous escalation.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark User Guide
sources.current_signal: DGX Spark is positioned as a compact AI development and deployment computer for developers, data scientists, and researchers.
sources.action_for_v508: Model local/edge compute readiness as a resource-envelope problem: storage, memory, runtime duration, and safe handoff evidence all need bounded receipts.

sources.current_signal: Rubin is described as a codesigned AI supercomputer platform spanning CPU, GPU, NVLink, networking, DPU, and Ethernet components.
sources.action_for_v508: Use the system-of-systems framing for THOS: runners, lanes, guards, receipts, and source ledgers should be codesigned rather than bolted together.

sources.title: Google Cloud Agent Platform scale guidance
sources.current_signal: Google frames production agents around runtime, sessions, memory, tracing, logging, monitoring, IAM identity, gateways, and sandboxed execution.
sources.action_for_v508: Promote watcher cadence, memory/vision cards, tracing receipts, and lane identities into the core multiplex design.

sources.title: Google Cloud Agent Development Kit
sources.current_signal: ADK is presented as an open-source framework for building, debugging, and deploying reliable multi-agent systems at enterprise scale.
sources.action_for_v508: Keep GHC helpers modular and testable: builders should generate receipts, validators should prove boundaries, and orchestration should remain recoverable.

sources.title: Google Cloud Agent Platform overview
sources.current_signal: The platform overview emphasizes agent build surfaces including ADK, Agent Studio, Agent Garden, and Model Garden.
sources.action_for_v508: Represent v508-v515 as a build surface map: planning, runners, routes, guards, source refresh, and approval packets should each have their own evidence row.

reflections.summary: Current sources reinforce that agent systems need explicit route identity and governance. The v508 carry gate should prioritize truthful open-lane receipts over fast phase advancement.
Codex CLI schema and web-search improvements make Node entrypoints a good fit for repeatable source ledgers, but every generated artifact still needs local validation and private-material guards.
Google's sessions and memory-bank framing maps cleanly to the user's vision-card request: phase starts and compaction boundaries should always recover current state, blockers, and next allowed work.
NVIDIA's platform codesign framing is useful as an analogy only: THOS should integrate lanes, watchers, validators, and ledgers as a coherent operating fabric, without making physics or canon claims.
OWASP agentic safety guidance supports keeping read-only permissions, no-replacement rules, raw-output suppression, and least-privilege route refresh as mandatory v508 controls.

next_actions: Use this ledger as the first v508 x1 source-refresh batch, not as the complete 30-source target.
Create a runner compatibility ledger for current Node entrypoints.
Create an identity and consent guardrail card that binds OWASP-style controls to GHC sibling lanes.
Keep full v508 phase start and x2 closeout blocked until route evidence or later gates explicitly permit them.
